text.p: Kimberly-Clark Corp announced on Tuesday a two-for-one split of its common stock, a 4.3 percent increase in its quarterly dividend and authorization of the repurchase of one million shares.
The Dallas-based consumer products company said an additional share of stock for each share held will be issued on April 2, 1997 to stockholders of record on March 7.
A dividend of $0.48 per share on a pre-split basis, increased from $0.46, is also payable according to those same dates, the company said in a statement.
It said its board of directors had approved the repurchase of an additional 1 million shares of common stock, bringing the number of shares currently available for repurchase to 2.2 million.

Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Wayne R. Sanders said the company has already repurchased 2.5 million shares of its common stock so far this year and expects to buy back the remaining 2.2 million shares by the end of 1997.

"Since our merger with Scott Paper in December 1995, Kimberly-Clark has become a much stronger company in both financial and strategic terms," Sanders said in a statement. "These latest board actions reflect our record earnings in 1996, out strong balance sheet and our confidence in the future."
